data.name: Nabirah
data.gender_notes: Nabirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nabirah is the name of a female companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and is mentioned in several Hadiths. She was the daughter of 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud, one of the ten promised Paradise. The name Nabirah carries the meaning “Given to the Prophet's daughter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nabirah usually hope their child will grow to embody given to the prophet's daughter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of faith and devotion to God
data.etymology: Nabirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Given to the Prophet's daughter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nabirah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
